title.fr_fr: Barre de combustible au thorium de la pile de Chicago

content.en_us:
How to get it :
No direct recipe: ore, loot, assembled structure or by-product. See JEI (R key).

Used to make :
[[gv:billet_thorium_fuel|Thorium Fuel Billet]], [[gv:billet_nuclear_waste|Nuclear Waste Billet]].
